segments.he: ״יוֹסֵף חׇפְנִי שִׁמְעוֹן אֶפְרָתִי, הֵם שִׁמְּשׁוּנִי בְּחַיַּי וְהֵם יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנִי בְּמוֹתִי״. סְבוּר מִינָּה בְּהָדֵין עָלְמָא הוּא דְּקָאָמַר, כֵּיוָן דַּחֲזוֹ דְּקָדֵים עַרְסַיְיהוּ לְעַרְסֵיהּ, אָמְרִי: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ לְהָהוּא עָלְמָא הוּא דְּקָאָמַר.
segments.en: The Gemara elaborates on Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi’s statement: «Yosef Ḥeifani» and «Shimon Efrati, they served me during my lifetime and they will serve me in my death.» It was «understood from» this statement that Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi «was speaking of this world,» that these two should serve him in his death and administer his burial. However, «when they saw that their biers preceded his bier,» i.e., they died before him, «they said: Conclude from here that he was speaking of that world.» They will attend to him in the World-to-Come.

moves.summary: They thought he meant this world
moves.about: first understood 'they will serve me in my death' as referring to this world (his burial)

moves.summary: Seeing them die first, they concluded he meant the next world
